about_the_game:
Ordinary people can also become millionaires. In the game, you can  get  money by transporting apples. Once you have accumulated a certain amount of money, you can own your own barbecue restaurant. From then on, becoming a millionaire is no longer a dream.

1. The game can be operated with just a mouse, simply by clicking and moving the mouse, without even dragging the mouse.

2. The game is divided into two parts, the first part is transporting apples, of course, there are many difficulties to overcome.

3. The difficulties in transporting apples can be overcome by upgrading skills, making transportation easier.

4. Once you earn $500, you can open a barbecue restaurant.

5. You need to purchase raw materials yourself, but you need to control inventory. In order to ensure the freshness of the food, all raw materials need to be discarded the next day.

6. You need to promote the restaurant yourself. Customers won't come to the restaurant without receiving the promotional flyer.

7. You need to set the price yourself. If the price is too high, you need to do more promotion to attract customers.

8. You need to provide food to customers yourself, and if you make a mistake, customers will not pay.

9. You can upgrade the chefs in your restaurant so that you can set higher prices without the need for further promotion.

10. At the end of each week, you have to pay rent, and if you go bankrupt, you will have to start shipping apples again.
